entities.summary: The Communist Party of Nicaragua is a communist party in Nicaragua. Founded as the Socialist Workers' Party in 1967, the core founding members were Juan Lorio, Augusto Lorío, Elí Altamirano and Manuel Pérez Estrada, who all had been expelled from the Nicaraguan Socialist Party on 23 April 1967.
